title: Ribasim realization of accepted WLSTAR band with bounded bidirectional management routes
purpose: Qualify the hydraulic realization layer after the coupler has already selected an accepted WLSTAR: Ribasim must keep the Basin inside [WLSTAR-WLDIP, WLSTAR] when capacity permits and expose unmet target when capacity is insufficient.

frozen_mapping.discharge_route: allocation-controlled Pump to Terminal with explicit max_flow_rate

hard_checks: No simultaneous nonzero supply and discharge in any case.
Neither realized route exceeds its frozen capacity.
Inside-band case has zero management transfer.
Capacity-limited cases remain outside the requested band by exactly the unresolved storage deficit/surplus within tolerance.
Basin storage change equals direct supply minus direct discharge.
q2b2_hold: Dynamic Q(h)-limited discharge is not part of Q2B1. Native TabulatedRatingCurve exactness is already falsified for the linear hard-kink law. Q2B2 must explicitly compose allocation with a separately qualified physical capacity representation.
pass_meaning: Ribasim can realize an accepted automatic-management level band with explicit bounded routes while remaining sole owner of surface-water storage and while exposing capacity shortfall rather than masking it.
